models.name: Майя
models.notes: The upstream README explicitly licenses mpfb.glb under CC0. The MakeHuman system asset index and source headers license long01 under CC0. The ponytail mesh was replaced programmatically with long01 without Blender; 52 ARKit face shapes, 14 non-silent Oculus visemes and all existing facial morph targets remain present. The runtime GLB is Meshopt-compressed and embeds a WebP hair texture. Runtime binary stays local and is not committed.
